result.quote: the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
result.reason: The old prophet’s next stated action is uniquely that he saddles the donkey for the man of God, so the key is supported. However, “after eating” can grammatically imply that the old prophet ate, while the passage specifically says the man of God finished eating and drinking. Clarify: “What did the old prophet do after the man of God finished eating and drinking?”
